scope: Observed HTTP protocol and frontend-derived Round/Delivery/Step state machine. UNKNOWN and PARTIAL branches are non-implementable.

transport.responseBody: JSON envelope {dt,err}; GameInfo was served as text/plain but parsed as JSON
transport.errorRule: Frontend invokes the success callback only when err is falsy; network/parse failures emit the network-error path.

endpointOrder.name: verifySession

responseDtFields.atk: authenticated session token transferred to later calls

endpointOrder.next: GameInfo/Get uses response dt.atk and dt.gdr

responseDtFields.totalList: permitted total-bet wire values; exact downstream normalization is frontend-owned
responseDtFields.round: initial active-row offset; frontend sets visible rows to clamp(3+round,0,6)

endpointOrder.name: Spin

paidRequestFields.bet: decimal total bet; 0.40 BRL legal UI minimum observed
paidRequestFields.gameType: 1 for ordinary paid play; other values are capability-gated

confirmedWireResponseDtFields.bl: step balance; 0 is allowed on nonterminal responses, but a positive value alone is not a Round termination oracle
confirmedWireResponseDtFields.free: wire mode marker consumed by frontend; exact legal-min Lucky Wagon semantics remain PARTIAL

endpointOrder.wireFieldWarning: Captured fixture projections contain derived fields for oracle use. end, ways, vaildRow, split/wild collections, multipliers and cumulative wins are not confirmed raw wire fields.
endpointOrder.next: Decode formation, derive the Delivery step, then either terminate or POST a zero-bet continuation.

requestFields.time_begin: epoch seconds used by active CPHistoryTY2
requestFields.time_end: epoch seconds used by active CPHistoryTY2

itemSemantics.formation: ordered array of all raw Step formations

freeMode.codeEvidence: frontend has a pipe-delimited parser with top/center/bottom sections
freeMode.implementationRule: Do not implement without a legal-min adjacent wire sample

derivedDeliveryFields.ways: product of non-blocked symbol multiplicities across active rows of all six columns
derivedDeliveryFields.vaildRow: frontend spelling; derived active-row counter beginning at 3
derivedDeliveryFields.winGridLines: left-to-right WAYS matches over at least 3 consecutive columns
derivedDeliveryFields.gloablMulti: frontend spelling; derived cumulative xBomb multiplier beginning at 1

transitions.condition: bet>0 and mult>0 with no unfinished Round

transitions.action: append raw step and decode formation

transitions.condition: frontend-derived win, xSplit, active xBomb, combine or free state
transitions.action: emit current Delivery and request bet=0,mult=0,gameType=1; local runtime generation remains limited to capability-allowed modes
append adjacent raw/derived step to same Round
publish final cumulative win and authoritative final balance

termination: No new paid request while a Round is active
All special/free steps remain attached to the originating paid Round

indexedButNotAdjacentResponseResolved.evidenceScope: request grouping and label only; per-step response formation/state content was not retained

rules.ways: Paytable multiplier times winning ways; same-symbol wins proceed left to right; a gap cancels later columns; only highest win per bet way is paid.
rules.collapse: Each paid Round starts with 3 active rows. A qualifying collapse opens one more row up to 6, removes evidenced win/xBomb cells, preserves every other raw child and its column order, compacts toward the higher row index, refills only active vacancies, and leaves buffer dirt/block unchanged.
rules.magicMining: Rules/frontend describe horizontal or vertical no-win alignments of 3/4/5/6 same symbols creating 1/2/3/4 Wilds. Fresh legal-min Round 7 has raw adjacent elimination/movement/refill evidence; formal local generation remains gated by the locked follow-up baseline.
rules.xSplit: Splits symbols in its line; Bonus and xSplit are excluded; activated xSplit becomes a regular symbol; affected dirt is removed when collapse occurs.
rules.xBombWild: Substitutes all symbols except Bonus; removes adjacent non-Bonus symbols; its value increases the next win multiplier; explodes before next collapse except when Magic Mining activates.
rules.luckyWagon: Rules captured, but legal-min execution contract is unavailable and implementation is prohibited.
rules.xBetAndBuy: Rules/entry mapping captured, but runtime contracts are unavailable and implementation is prohibited.

implementationGates.fixtureRule: Fixtures are independent protocol oracles only and may never be read as runtime result sources.
